senses.gloss: m. (מָאַס) repulsiveness, creating aversion.—מחמת מ׳, v. מוּקְצֶה.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 2:1:13">Y. Maas. Sh. II, 53ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:3:5">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᶜ</cite> <he>מִאוּס היא</he> it is a nauseous manipulation (and therefore forbidden on the Sabbath, v. <cite ref="M00596"><he>מוּקְצֶה</he></cite>).
